2: To the Overseer. --By sons of Korah. A Psalm. All ye peoples, clap the hand, Shout to God with a voice of singing,
3: For Jehovah Most High is fearful, A great king over all the earth.
4: He leadeth peoples under us, and nations under our feet.
5: He doth choose for us our inheritance, The excellency of Jacob that He loves. Selah.
6: God hath gone up with a shout, Jehovah with the sound of a trumpet.
7: Praise God--praise--give praise to our king, praise.
8: For king of all the earth is God, Give praise, O understanding one.
9: God hath reigned over nations, God hath sat on His holy throne,
10: Nobles of peoples have been gathered, With the people of the God of Abraham, For to God are the shields of earth, Greatly hath He been exalted!
